title: Back matter: a verse of the Qur’an (boxed)
headingPashto: وروستۍ پاڼې: قرآني آیت (په چوکاټ کې)

paras.en: Do not unjustly eat one another’s wealth among yourselves. (Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 188)
paras.ur: ایک دوسرے کا مال آپس میں ناحق نہ کھاؤ۔ (سورۃ البقرہ آیت 188)
paras.ps: یو د بل مال په خپلو کې په ناحقه مه خورئ. (سورة البقره، آیت ۱۸۸)

sourceNote: A page with no printed number and no "Not for Sale" line: a decorative box containing the Urdu text of Al-Baqarah 2:188 (“ایک دوسرے کا مال آپس میں ناحق نہ کھاؤ”) with its reference; the rest of the page is blank. It is a filler/quotation page after the last numbered page 137 and is treated as back matter. The scan lies before the next boxed-quotation page in photograph order. The English and Pashto columns are our translations; the Arabic is read from the scan with its vowel marks and needs checking against the source texts. The watermark and "Whatsapp" strip are excluded.
